name: rawbbit-game-events
description: Design and maintain Rawbbit game events with bundled SDKs and optional live compatibility lookup.

interface.longDescription: Design a game-specific Rawbbit event map, integrate approved events with the bundled Unity or browser-game SDK, and maintain or migrate existing analytics events. An optional public read-only MCP catalog provides current SDK revisions, target evidence, and Collector contract facts; it does not receive game source, app IDs, keys, or telemetry. The bundled SDKs remain available offline. A local game checkout and desktop execution are required. Unity Editor and device compatibility must be verified in the consuming game; the package does not claim universal target support.
capabilities: Integrate bundled Unity and browser-game SDKs
Migrate and maintain existing game events
defaultPrompt: Inspect this game and propose a Rawbbit event map without changing code.
Integrate the approved Rawbbit events into this browser game using the bundled SDK.
Review existing game events and plan a safe migration to Rawbbit.
